sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Live-recording date checks: the "(N) WARNING ⚠️" and "(N) ERROR ❌" summary buttons counted only the rows a filter happened to leave on screen, so any filter that hid the flagged tracks made the button vanish — taking away the only way back to them — and a filter that hid some of them quietly understated the count.
Both buttons now count the whole tracklist, so they stay available with their real numbers whatever is filtered, exactly as the track/recording length mismatch buttons already did.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt says the counts describe the whole tracklist rather than the filtered view.
